title: ExamEntryOutboundV1
description: Outbound exam entry batch generated by POST /api/v1/exam-boards/{boardId}/exam-entries/generate. Contains one record per module registration that has been registered for a formal exam. Transmitted to the exam scheduling system so that candidate numbers, seat assignments, and timetable slots can be assigned.

entryCount.description: Number of exam entry records in this batch.

entries.description: Exam entry records to transmit to the exam scheduling system.

examEntryId.description: SRS exam entry UUID. Idempotency key for the exam scheduling system.

examBoardId.description: SRS exam board UUID that generated these entries.

candidateNumber.description: Candidate number assigned by the exam scheduling system. Null until assigned.

scheduledDate.description: ISO 8601 UTC scheduled exam date/time. Null until the timetable is published.

roomReference.description: Exam room reference assigned by the exam scheduling system. Null until timetable is published.

statusCode.description: Exam entry status. Values: 'pending' (submitted, awaiting scheduling), 'scheduled' (candidate number and timetable slot assigned), 'cancelled' (entry withdrawn).

accommodations.description: Approved physical exam accommodations for this student (from the adjustment record). Keys are accommodation type codes; values are accommodation details. Must be transmitted alongside the entry for the exam scheduling system to apply.

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 UTC valid-time of this exam entry record.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC transaction time when this entry was recorded in SRS.
